t: This Magnusson timber loft ladder provides a robust and energy-efficient solution for attic access in residential properties. Featuring an insulated trapdoor, it helps prevent heat loss, making it ideal for domestic renovations and new build projects focused on energy efficiency. The spring-assisted stowage mechanism ensures effortless opening and closing, while non-slip flat treads and a heavy-duty handrail offer enhanced safety during use. Suitable for floor to ceiling heights up to 2.86m and supporting a static vertical load of 150kg, this durable loft ladder is a practical choice for reliable and secure loft entry.
b: Spring-Assisted Stowage for Smooth Opening & Closing
